technique_name: Compare and contrast the benefits of using Apache Cassandra and MongoDB.
description: Apache Cassandra and MongoDB are two popular data stores used in software applications. Cassandra is a highly scalable, open source, NoSQL database developed by the Apache Software Foundation, while MongoDB is an open-source document-oriented database developed by MongoDB, Inc. Cassandra is known for its high availability and scalability, whereas MongoDB offers high performance and scalability.
